purpose: 逻辑职责与实际输入/输出/所有权；不是多内核抽象、不是每行一个Gradle模块，亦不是WebView通用适配层。
numericAuthorityBinding: capabilityGroupRef is coverage only; mixed-risk groups must be split per action before final level binding. Internal methods are not individually public debug endpoints.
invariants: Source/data gate before engine/DB/connector/job restore; recheck target binding before commit
UI and administrator actions call same domain method; caller-package identity is not extra permission gate
Pause/stop/cancel/close of already-owned work do not depend on fresh site login
Quiescence and actual settlement cannot be supplied as booleans by external clients
Clock deadlines/port disconnect/retired context do not prove cancelled remote effect or freed disk
